__broaden__.δίδου: δίδωμι — give; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’give!’ · also impf. 3 sg., epic (= ἐδίδου): ’she gave’ (of the Muse)
__broaden__.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’)
__broaden__.μακρὸν: μακρός — long, far; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’far, loudly’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with a noun: ’tall’ (κίονα μακρὸν ’a tall pillar’)
__broaden__.πομπῆς: πομπή — sending, escort, conveyance; fem. gen. sg., + gen. with τυγχάνω · also gen. governed by περί: ’about a conveyance’ · also gen. governed by εἵνεκα: ’on account of an escort’
__broaden__.τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’)
__broaden__.ἔρχεσθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. inf., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθαι) · also pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθε): ’come!’
__broaden__.ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’
__broaden__.ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’) · also + opt., in a repeated past clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂψ ἄρχοιτο ’whenever he began again’)
__broaden__.ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’)
__broaden__.ἀμφί: ἀμφί — around, about, on both sides of; prep. + acc. · also preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφί … ἕπον = ἀμφέπον ’busied themselves about, dressed’)
__broaden__.κίονα: κίων — pillar, column; fem. acc. sg. (κίων is feminine in this use) · also masc. acc. sg., with μακρὸν agreeing in the masculine: ’a tall pillar’ (πρὸς κίονα μακρὸν)
__broaden__.πορφύρεον: πορφύρεος — dark-gleaming, surging, seething (of water, not a colour term here); neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with κῦμα · also of a cloak, a colour term: ’purple, dark red’; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with φᾶρος (πορφύρεον … φᾶρος ’a purple cloak’)
__broaden__.ἀνῆκεν: ἀνίημι — let go, release; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’let go, released’ · also ’urge on, incite’ (+ acc. and inf.): ἀοιδὸν ἀνῆκεν ἀειδέμεναι ’moved the minstrel to sing’
__broaden__.ἵκετ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented and elided (ἵκετ’ = ἵκετο) · also augmented, with the long ι that the metre needs (ἵκετ’ ἐμὸν δῶ ’came to my house’)
